items.exampleEn: I always forget the comparative of 'good'.
items.exampleZh: 我老是忘記 good 的比較級。

items.exampleEn: I got nine out of ten on the quiz.
items.exampleZh: 這次小考我拿了十分中的九分。

items.exampleEn: A verb tells us what someone does.
items.exampleZh: 動詞說明一個人在做什麼。
everyone 後面要用單數動詞。

items.exampleEn: This adjective is new to me.
Many schoolchildren walk to school here.
items.exampleZh: 這裡很多學童走路上學。

items.exampleEn: Please clean the blackboard after class.
items.exampleZh: 下課後請把黑板擦乾淨。

items.exampleEn: A noun can be a person, a place or a thing.
items.exampleZh: 名詞可以是人、地方或東西。

items.sentenceEn: We have a quiz on chapter two tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 我們明天要考第二章的小考。

items.audioEn: The teacher wrote three new verbs on the blackboard.
items.audioZh: 老師在黑板上寫了三個新的動詞。
items.questionZh: 老師在黑板上寫了什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Find the noun and the verb in this sentence.
items.sentenceZh: 找出這個句子裡的名詞和動詞。

items.stemEn: Run, eat and sleep are all ____.
items.stemZh: run、eat 和 sleep 都是動詞。

items.stemEn: We have a ____ in math class every Monday.
items.stemZh: 我們每週一的數學課都有小考。

items.passageEn: Ms. Lin teaches English to schoolchildren. Every Friday, she gives them a short quiz. Last week, she wrote some words on the blackboard and asked, "Which ones are nouns, and which ones are verbs?" Then the children used adjectives to describe their pets, and one boy said his cat was always sleepy. Next week, they will learn the comparative of adjectives.
items.passageZh: 林老師教小學生英文。每週五她都會給他們一個小考。上週，她在黑板上寫了一些字，問大家：「哪些是名詞，哪些是動詞？」接著孩子們用形容詞描述自己的寵物，有個男孩說他的貓總是很睏。下週他們要學形容詞的比較級。

items.promptZh: 這個名詞是單數還是複數？
referenceEn: Is this noun singular or plural?
Is this noun in the singular or the plural?
rubricZh: 「單數」用 singular；「複數」可寫，例如 plural 等
問句把 be 動詞放前面（例如 Is this noun…?）

items.promptZh: 我看不清楚黑板上的字。
referenceEn: I can't see the words on the blackboard clearly.
I can't read the words on the blackboard.
rubricZh: 用 blackboard 表示「黑板」（例如 on the blackboard）
「看不清楚」可寫，例如 can't see…clearly、can't read 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：要求「複數」用 plural，但 plural 是下一課（l06）才教的新字；本課學習者尚未學過，翻譯題的評分點應改為「例如 plural」或把題目改成只考 singular。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "「單數」用 singular；「複數」可寫，例如 plural 等"（原 "「單數」用 singular、「複數」用 plural"）；plural 是下一課的字，改為「例如」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：正解選項明顯是最長的一個（"Three new verbs" 15 字元 vs 9），違反「正解不落在最長集合」；應縮短正解或加長干擾項。
